name: play
title: PLAY tape screen
summary: The tape key opens PLAY instead of TE's tape screen (which is not reachable in an image with play; TE's tape data stays untouched): one list of up to 8 tracks, each AUDIO (a WAV / AIF from disk mode's play/ folder, looped or once, streamed from flash), SYNTH (NOTE ROLL patterns on an SDK engine with one of the 8 synth sounds; up to 8 SYNTH tracks share 3 engine instances, at most 3 sound at once, TE's envelope, PLAY's decimator) or DRUM (DRUM ROLL patterns on PLAY's own sample player from TE's kits, in place), all sample-locked from bar 1, with level, mute, solo, master and a bar counter; the mix joins TE's master bus like the tape (master EQ, master FX, mixer drive and volume act on it). A tracker song arranges the tracks (join: song view, 128 rows x one column per track, each column with its own playhead; chain view: 16 rows of pattern + transpose, audition; AUDIO cells ON / OF; live mode: rows and cells cued while playing); it lives in SONG.BIN with the track list. When disk mode is left, a hook in TE's disk sync copies play/ into /yaffs2/user/play_a|play_b before TE clears the disk (the only writes, with SONG.BIN and the rendered files in /yaffs2/user/play_r).

entry_hooks.what: TE's metronome mix into the master bus (audio interrupt, every block, before master EQ / FX / drive / volume): after it, PLAY adds its sum into the int16 bus 0xff800d34 / 0xff800db4, so TE's master section acts on it like on the tape

call_sites.what: disk mode left without changes: before TE deletes the image's root entries, import play/
sync after a restart: before TE deletes the image's root entries, import play/
defragment check (every boot, and on the way out of disk mode): before its cleanup, import play/

controls: tape key: PLAY's track list, also from the song / chain view (TE's own tape screen and its erase screen, shift + tape, are not reachable in this image); join on any other screen: PLAY's song view
PLAY: a list of up to 8 tracks (AUDIO / SYNTH / DRUM); blue turn cursor, blue press mute, green turn level, green press solo

PLAY: white turn = the track's file (AUDIO) or sound / kit slot 1-8 (held at the ends), white press = LOOP / ONCE (AUDIO) or voices 2 / 4 / 1 (SYNTH), shift + white press = ECO (SYNTH: the engine at 44.1 kHz, half the cost); orange turn = pattern 1-14, held at the ends (SYNTH: NOTE ROLL, DRUM: DRUM ROLL; a track with a longer song: SNG, edited in the song view); shift + orange turn = master
PLAY: + ADD row: white turn the type, white press adds; insert twice = a new track before the cursor's; cut twice = remove the track
PLAY: play start / pause, stop pause / again back to bar 1, back / forward one bar, T1-T4 cursor (shift: mute), orange press re-read the set folder
disk mode: WAV / AIF files (+ set.txt with bpm) in a play/ folder are imported when disk mode is left
PLAY: shift + blue press on a SYNTH / DRUM track: its pattern in NOTE ROLL / DRUM ROLL over PLAY, the playhead follows PLAY; shift + blue press closes it

PLAY: join = the song view (one column per track): blue turn row, green turn column, white turn the cell (chain 00-7F or OF = a rest of one bar; AUDIO: ON / OF), white press = last chain / open the chain view / ON-OF, shift + white press = new chain / clone, cut / insert = cell clipboard, shift + insert = new song row, shift + cut twice = delete it, play = from the cursor row, orange press / tape = back (join stays: join always means the song view, live mode too)

PLAY: live mode (shift + rec in the song view): play = cue the cursor row on every column, white press = cue the cursor cell, T1-T4 = mute (shift: solo); a column jumps to its cue when its chain (AUDIO: its ON / OF segment) ends; shift + play cues a row in the song view too

PLAY: rec in the song view / live mode = render: white turn the length in bars, rec again starts, stop cancels; the song from the cursor row is written as RENDnn.AIF (16 bit, 44.1 kHz, SYNTH tracks without ECO and with all voices, not in real time) into /yaffs2/user/play_r and can be picked on an AUDIO track
PLAY: keys 1-8 = sound / kit 1-8 of the cursor track at once (list, song view, live, chain view); chain view: a third column SND = the slot the track plays while that row plays (-: the track's own)
PLAY: speech = a help page for the current view (blue turn: pages, any key: back)

PLAY: chain view: blue turn row, green turn PAT / TSP / SND, white turn the value (shift: octaves), white press = last pattern, cut / insert = row clipboard, shift + insert / shift + cut twice = insert / delete a row, play = audition the chain alone, join / orange press = back to the song view
PLAY: while playing, CPU in the header = PLAY's share of the audio time, the number on a SYNTH / DRUM row = that track's share

evidence.what: device (op1play): boots; tape opens PLAY, tape again TE's tape; play/ (A1 wav 2:08 stereo + A2/A3 aif loops + set.txt) imported on leaving disk mode; plays in sync with LOOP, transport, mute/solo/level/master, volume knob and speaker act on PLAY, keeps playing on other screens
